why.title: Built for operators, not vanity launches
why.description: We focus on systems your teams actually run: clear architecture, measurable performance, and software that still makes sense a year from now.
why.feature1Desc: Lean iterations and tight feedback loops — without cutting structural corners.
why.feature2Desc: Data models, permissions, and integrations are designed before pixels.
why.feature3Desc: Operational reality informs how we scope, build, and harden products.

about.title: About
about.heroSubtitle: A technology partner for products and operational software.
about.intro: MK Digital Systems builds digital systems — SaaS-style products, internal tools, dashboards, and integrations. Design and engineering sit in one workflow: we optimize for reliability, clarity, and what your operators need day to day, not for decorative homepages alone.
about.howWeWork1: Scope, stakeholders, and success metrics are agreed before heavy build work.
about.howWeWork2: Single thread of communication; decisions and trade-offs stay visible.
about.howWeWork3: Timeline, milestones, and change process are explicit — no surprise scope.
about.howWeWork4: Performance, accessibility, and security are baseline, not optional add-ons.
about.howWeWork5: After go-live we stay available for iteration, hardening, and small extensions.
about.whatWeDeliver1: Customer-facing and internal web products on modern stacks (e.g. Next.js).
about.whatWeDeliver2: Admin consoles, role-based dashboards, and operational control surfaces.
about.whatWeDeliver3: APIs, automations, CMS-backed properties, and third-party integrations.
about.whatWeDeliver4: Hardening existing systems: performance, UX clarity, technical debt reduction.
about.whatWeDeliver5: Architectures intended to evolve — logging, env separation, and maintainable boundaries.
